senses.en_definition: The act or state of controlling, regulating, guarding, or supervising.
A person or thing under guard, supervision, or control.

messages.en: It's really crowded here at the entrance. Can you still manage? Want me to come over and help?
I'm managing. Things are still under control. You look after the counter for now. I've already asked two more people to come and help.

senses.en_definition: A friend or companion in everyday life.
Someone who shares an activity or occupation with another; a companion or colleague.
A group of animals or people, especially a herd, flock, or gang.
Colloquial: a spouse or life partner.
Something eaten or chewed as an accompaniment to another food or substance.

collocations.en: side dishes to eat with rice

senses.en_definition: Johor colloquial: a first-person pronoun meaning I or me.

messages.en: Can I bring a friend along tomorrow? He's just moved here and doesn't know many people yet.
Of course! What's his name? I'll add one more person to the restaurant booking.
His name's Danish. Thanks! I'll invite him to this group later so you can all get to know him.

senses.en_definition: An area or stretch of land, whether small or extensive.
An area or territory under a particular government, administration, or authority.
A region sharing particular geographical, climatic, resource, or economic characteristics.
Negeri Sembilan dialect: a homestead, privately owned land, or the grounds of a house.

messages.en: Sis, is there a laundry place around here? I need to wash this thick blanket.
Yes, right next to that grocery shop. You can just walk there. It's close by.

senses.en_definition: Having a great deal of money or property; wealthy.
Having or containing an abundance of something.
Supremely great and powerful, used as an epithet of God.
Kaya, a sweet spread made from coconut milk, eggs, and sugar.

messages.en: Let's have breakfast at Uncle Din's place tomorrow. His kaya toast is really good, and he makes the kaya himself.
Sounds good. If you get there first, order a set for me too. I'll be there around eight.
